summary:
Every rating across the board is scorching the same two ways right now, and it's not subtle. R1 through R4 are all sitting 4-1 (80%, n=5) over the last 14 days across trends, runs, sp, bullpen, and hitting — a uniform spike well above their season baselines (low-to-mid 50s across the board). But flip to bullpen_fatigue and it's a mirror image: all four ratings are 0-5 (0%, n=5) with a active 5-game losing streak. That's the single clearest signal in the data — fade bullpen_fatigue picks today, lean into everything else. SP also carries a 3-game win streak on top of its 80% window for every rating, reinforcing that starting-pitcher-driven picks are the trustworthy core right now.

For today's board, the category-combo data backs up leaning on trends+sp (58.0%, 370-268) and trends+runs (57.3%, 404-301) as your highest-confidence agreement pairs — when those two line up on the same side, that's the strongest signal in the model historically, and it's exactly the profile riding hot the last two weeks. On team trust, keep LAD and BOS at the top of the list if either shows up today: LAD's strong-play record is 28-7 (80%, +27.0u) and BOS sits at 22-7 (76%, +19.0u) — both clear the field for reliability when the model likes them strongly. MIL and TBR remain solid floor plays (69-70% win rate, n=63-74) but without the elite strong-play upside of LAD/BOS. Avoid leaning on NYY today even if R-ratings like them — 49% overall and a losing strong-play mark (9-14, -4.0u) makes that team a fade when it shows up as a side. Bottom line: trust the trends/sp/runs combo, ride LAD and BOS if they're in action, and steer completely away from any pick driven by bullpen_fatigue until that 0-5 cold streak breaks.
